description: Demolition of existing single storey and replacement of upgraded single storey rear extension, enlarging 1no window, 2no new rooflights, erection of garden studio, repair work to windows and front facade and landscape works to the front and rear gardens.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The works hereby approved shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the approved Tree Protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement. The measures set out in the Tree Protection Plan shall remain in place until the completion of the construction. Any permanent hard surfacing within Root Protection Areas of retained trees should be installed and maintained in line with the approved AMS using a ‘no-dig’ method as outlined within the report.</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"></p><p><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity,</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">All tree works, including pruning and removals, approved as part of this decision notice shall be carried out in strict accordance with the recommendations of British Standard BS 3998:2010 "Tree work – Recommendations" (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard).</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"></p><p><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To ensure that all tree work is undertaken to a professional standard, promoting the health, safety, and longevity of retained trees and safeguarding the visual amenities of the area.</span></p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of development, a qualified tree specialist must be appointed to
provide arboricultural supervision and inspection. The details of this appointment and the specialist's
responsibilities must be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The submission
should include the methodology and program for reporting, as well as a timetable for inspections.
The approved works must be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details.</p><p>REASON: to ensure that works affecting trees are carried out in a professional and controlled manner,
safeguarding their health and long-term viability. This is in accordance with good arboricultural practice and is
supported by BS 5837:2012 and Policy LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The outbuilding's foundation and sub-structure within the Root Protection Area (RPA) of the retained trees shall be implemented in strict accordance with the following requirements:</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Foundation Type: The foundation for the outbuilding shall be constructed using screw piles. No traditional strip foundations, continuous beams, or trenching shall be used within the RPA of T1 from the approved Arboricultural Report.&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The finished sub-structure shall be a suspended ground floor/slab creating a ventilated air space between the underside of the structure and the existing soil surface to ensure</span><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">gaseous exchange and maintain a healthy rooting environment.&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The design should encourage the natural movement and infiltration of rainfall into the soil beneath the structure.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To safeguard the long-term health, stability, and viability of the retained tree(s) by minimizing soil disturbance in accordance with the principles of BS 5837:2012 "Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction – Recommendations</span><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"></span></p>

<p>Prior to superstructure works, a detailed specification, drainage layout, and management and maintenance plan (where applicable) for the proposed permeable resin-bound gravel to the driveway, together with suitable sustainable drainage measures for the rear extension and outbuilding (i.e. water butts with overflows, rain gardens, bioretention planter boxes, living roofs with substrate depth of 80–150 mm excluding the vegetative mat, or permeable paving), shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.&nbsp; The development shall be implemented as per the approved details.&nbsp;</p><p><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To reduce the risks from surface water flooding. </span>To protect and, where possible, enhance biodiversity leading to a net gain.</p><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div>

<p>Following the removal of the tree, hereby approved,&nbsp; the tree shall be replaced by one
of the same species in the same vicinity unless first agreed otherwise by the local planning authority. The
replacement tree shall be planted during the planting season at the time of felling (end October - end March) or
during the next immediately available planting season. The size of the tree shall be at least a Selected
Standard as per BS 3936-1:1992 (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard). The tree shall be
maintained for 5 years after planting, and should it be removed, die, be severely damaged, or become seriously
diseased within this period, it shall be replaced with another tree as originally required to be planted by this
condition.
</p><p>REASON: In the interests of the visual amenities of the surrounding area.</p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-9856d151-7fff-649d-ba64-945feb456fe9"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-0c312444-7fff-4b45-8f49-e9924165ac9c"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, in writing, before the relevant work begins. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved:-</span></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">i) details of front gate;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">ii) details of brick piers; and </span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">iii) details of roof light.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-b5d11938-7fff-f026-8b12-64016b9f0dcb"></span></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenities</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;"> of the area.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Upon completion of the development, a report from the appointed arboriculturist must be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, confirming that all tree protection measures and tree works were carried out in accordance with the approved plans, accompanied by photographs taken at critical stages.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-481a076d-7fff-eae4-c989-cdece1b92df7"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: to ensure that works affecting trees are carried out in a professional and controlled manner, safeguarding their health and long-term viability. This is in accordance with good arboricultural practice and is supported by BS 5837:2012 and Policy LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033</span><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">.</span></p>

<p>All new underground utility apparatus, including drainage, shall be routed and installed outside the
Root Protection Area(s) (RPAs) shown on the approved drawings. Should it not be feasible to route new
underground utility apparatus outside the RPAs of retained trees, trenchless insertion methods (as detailed in
BS 5837:2012, Table 3) shall be employed for their installation within the RPAs, with entry and retrieval pits
sited outside the RPAs. No other new underground utilities shall be installed within the RPAs of retained trees
without prior written consent from the local planning authority (LPA). Any such works, if permitted, shall be
carried out in strict accordance with the principles of BS 5837:2012 "Trees in relation to design, demolition and
construction – Recommendations" and the National Joint Utilities Group Guidelines for the planning, installation
and maintenance of utility apparatus in proximity to trees, Volume 4, Issue 2 (2007) (or any standard that
reproduces or replaces this standard).
</p><p>REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity and long-term tree health, having
regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020). Prior approval is required to ensure that important
trees are not permanently damaged or lost due to root disturbance or changes in soil hydrology.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Full details, with samples naming the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building, including the outbuilding, rear extension, and front boundary treatment, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, in writing, before the relevant work commences. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.44; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-9082d648-7fff-295b-a2f6-5ae6e5a156e3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenities of the area</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">.</span></p>
